headline: CodeBuild role has unrestricted administrative permissions
suppressed: Pre-existing security gaps (unencrypted RDS, no S3 logging, missing database hardening) are not introduced by this change and are outside scope.

findings.evidence_ref: iam.tf lines 55-67: `Action: "*"` and `Resource: "*"` grants complete IAM permissions across the entire AWS account
findings.explanation: The CodeBuild deployment role will have unrestricted access to all AWS services and resources in this account, including the ability to read/modify/delete the production RDS database (acme-prod-db) and all S3 buckets. This remains in place until explicitly scoped down. While you acknowledged this is temporary, any compromise or misconfiguration of a CodeBuild job during this window could result in data loss or infrastructure sabotage. Recommend applying this change only after having a concrete plan and timeline for scope-down in place.
